item.content:encoded:
News / U.Today / Binance to Remove Five Crypto Trading Pairs in 24 Hours: Countdown Begins

Binance to Remove Five Crypto Trading Pairs in 24 Hours: Countdown Begins 1 min read

GASTRY HBARBNB HIVETRY KSMTRY Binance will delist five crypto spot trading pairs within the next 24 hours on Nov. 20, 2026, following a review. To protect its users and to ensure a high-quality trading market, Binance conducts regular reviews of all listed spot trading pairs; it may delist certain spot trading pairs for various reasons, including low liquidity and trading volume. Binance will delist GASTRY , HBARBNB , HIVETRY , KSMTRY and ZAMATRY pairs on November 20, 2026 at 03:00 UTC, according to an official announcement published on November 18. Four of the five affected pairs are related to the Turkish lira TRY , while the last one is HBARBNB . The decision affects trading between these specific assets and does not mean the cryptocurrencies themselves are being completely delisted from Binance. The exchange clarified that users will still be able to trade the affected tokens through other available spot trading pairs on its platform. Binance will terminate Spot Trading Bots services for the spot trading pairs simultaneously where applicable. Users are strongly advised to update and/or cancel their Spot Trading Bots prior to the cessation of services for Spot Trading Bots to avoid any potential losses. Binance Margin to perform routine cleanup In related news, Binance Margin will initiate a routine cleanup of Cross Margin accounts with collateral valued at less than 1 USD (or equivalent in other assets), effective from November 30, 2026 at 00:00 (UTC). The cleanup will be executed on a daily basis as an ongoing operational process. Affected accounts include Cross Margin Accounts with a collateral value of less than 1 USD equivalent across all assets and no outstanding liabilities, as well as Margin Accounts with no capital activity in the past 6 months. Capital activity refers to any action that generates a capital flow. For each eligible Small-Asset Account, the system will automatically transfer the collateral in users’ Margin Accounts to their Spot Accounts while the Margin Account functions remain normal, allowing users to transfer, borrow, or trade at any time after the cleanup. Accounts with collateral equal to or exceeding 1 USD equivalent are not affected by this cleanup.

Cartesi to Close Vote on CTSI MinterRole Renunciation on November 25th Less than 1 min read

Cartesi will close voting on November 25th on a proposal to renounce the remaining MinterRole permissions in the CTSI token contract. The voting period runs from November 18th–25th following a 21-day consultation. Refer to the official tweet by CTSI:

Cartesi @cartesiproject

Itâ€™s time to vote! The proposal to renounce the remaining MinterRole permissions on the $CTSI token contract is now open for voting, following a 21-day consultation period. Review the details and cast your vote here: https://t.co/qfaEWpIK5k Voting period 🗓ï¸ Nov 18 - Nov 25 pic.twitter.com/EywpwXewyy

Nov 18, 2026

CTSI Info Cartesi (CTSI) is a blockchain project aiming to make the development and deployment of decentralized applications (DApps) more practical and scalable. It does this by enabling smart contracts to run off-chain computations in a Linux environment, which opens up the possibility to use mainstream programming languages and software, as well as access larger amounts of data more efficiently. The fundamental piece of technology behind Cartesi is the Descartes SDK, a software development kit that provides a set of tools and services to help developers build scalable and secure DApps. With Descartes, computations can be intensive and incorporate complex business logic as they are executed off-chain in a Linux environment. The Cartesi token (CTSI) serves multiple utility purposes within the Cartesi ecosystem. It is used as a staking mechanism in the network's Proof-of-Stake (PoS) consensus algorithm, and also as a means to pay for computational resources within the network. In addition, it's used in the network's incentive system for data availability and computation verification.

SKALE to Hold Live Stream on November 19th Less than 1 min read

SKLUSD

SKALE will broadcast episode 3 of SKALE Spotlight on November 19th at 16:00 UTC. The discussion will cover the AgentPit Kickoff Clash and programmable privacy. Refer to the official tweet by SKL:

SKALE @SkaleNetwork

The Pit is heating up. Privacy is taking center stage. 🎙ï¸ SKALE Spotlight Episode 3 is breaking down the AgentPit Kickoff Clash and diving deep into Programmable Privacy. Join @iFalcore , @oibaftom , @dmtkatwork & @rikon_azane live tomorrow 8am PT! pic.twitter.com/SjHfK0U4Xi

Nov 18, 2026

SKL Info SKALE is a high-throughput, gas-free network of interconnected, modular blockchains. Designed to enhance Ethereum projects, it provides a scalable environment for developers to shift their projects from Ethereum, achieving better performance. Operating in tandem with Ethereum, SKALE leverages its unique consensus mechanism. It effectively marries Ethereum’s proof-of-stake (PoS) framework with SKALE’s pooled security model. This synergy results in secure, rapid transactions devoid of gas fees, positioning SKALE as an efficient platform, particularly for Web3 and gaming applications, enhancing Ethereum’s scalability for wider adoption. SKL, the utility token of SKALE, is an ERC-777 token, maintaining backward compatibility with the ERC-20 standard. Offering token-level delegation, it enables non-custodial staking directly from user wallets, bypassing traditional smart contract locks. Within the network, SKL finds its use in payments, especially for SKALE chain subscriptions. Token holders, be it as validators or delegators, can stake SKL to earn rewards. Validators, by running nodes, ensure the network's security, transaction validation, and smart contract execution, earning SKL in return. Delegators, while playing a passive role, earn a fraction of these rewards.

News / Coindar / Enjin Coin to Add Fort Canning Support to Enjin Wallet in November

Important

Enjin Coin to Add Fort Canning Support to Enjin Wallet in November 1 min read

ENJUSD

Enjin Coin will update Enjin Wallet in November to support the features introduced by the Fort Canning upgrade. These features are already available on NFT.io and the Enjin Platform following the completed Relaychain and Matrixchain upgrades. Refer to the official tweet by ENJ:

Enjin @enjin

The Fort Canning upgrade is complete 🎉 The Enjin Relaychain upgraded on Nov 9 and the Matrixchain on Nov 16, wrapping up the largest upgrade in Enjin Blockchain history. The new features are live on https://t.co/BX9xgM9Tt3 and the Enjin Platform, and a new version of Enjinâ€¦ pic.twitter.com/wfNAoMXuzN

Nov 17, 2026

ENJ Info Enjin is a comprehensive platform designed around the intersection of blockchain and gaming. Spearheaded by Enjin, this ecosystem offers a suite of interconnected gaming products with the Enjin Network at its core, where users engage in social gaming activities, including the creation of gaming websites, clans, chat forums, and virtual item storefronts. Central to Enjin’s functionality is its ability to let developers tokenize in-game items on the Ethereum blockchain. Through this mechanism, real-world value is imparted to these digital assets, enabling their purchase, sale, and trade on integrated marketplaces. This digitization process does more than just virtualize items; it brings transparency, verifies authenticity, and guarantees the scarcity of the tokenized assets, enhancing their inherent value and utility across various applications. Serving as the backbone of the Enjin ecosystem is the Enjin Coin (ENJ), an ERC-20 token. This digital store of value is integral to the creation and backing of blockchain assets, especially non-fungible tokens (NFTs). Every NFT produced within the Enjin platform has ENJ embedded within it, effectively locking this value and removing the corresponding ENJ from the general circulation. This system not only ensures that the assets possess inherent value but also provides liquidity and introduces an anti-inflationary model. Furthermore, Enjin’s distinctive “melting” feature grants users the option to dissolve their assets, subsequently reclaiming the intrinsic ENJ.
